comment: The two mutations issue #1008's case owes (tasks 3.2): the suite admitted back into the gate's predicate, and the gate's own program dropped from it. One mutation per invariant, `spend#aFocusedSuiteRunIsNotTheItemsGate` must go red on each, the file is restored and the case must go green again. Run with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations openspec/changes/<this change>/evidence/spend-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule. Every search is a single line and unique in its file.

mutations.why: the suite admitted to the gate's predicate — the defect `GATE_RE` carried, so the split lands on the suite's turn (84 000) instead of the gate's (47 000)
the gate's own program dropped from the predicate, so no call is a gate run: no session gated, and the share prints 0 rather than the tail after the gate's turn
